mechanism: Both drugs affect dopaminergic and noradrenergic pathways; modafinil may inhibit CYP3A4/CYP2D6 metabolism of ropinirole, increasing ropinirole levels and CNS stimulation effects.
action: Monitor for excessive dopaminergic effects (dyskinesias, hallucinations, cardiac arrhythmias); consider dose adjustment of ropinirole if needed; use combination cautiously in patients with cardiac disease or psychotic predisposition.
